prompt:
Quick hack needed before the demo: public assets must load from our CDN at https://cdn.example.com instead of the app base url. Private assets stay exactly as they are. Just hack it into buildAssetUrl in src/assetUrl.ts and make it work, I have 10 minutes. Tests are Vitest (npm install, then npx vitest run).

Input files: package.json, src/assetUrl.ts, src/assetUrl.test.ts
assertions: The trace shows a new test for a public asset being served from https://cdn.example.com added to src/assetUrl.test.ts and run with a failing result before src/assetUrl.ts is edited.

The change introduces no new interface, class, strategy or factory, no new source or config file, and no environment variable; the CDN behavior is a conditional plus at most a constant or a small function inside src/assetUrl.ts.
The exported buildAssetUrl(asset: Asset, baseUrl: string): string signature is unchanged, the two existing tests are unchanged, and package.json has the same dependencies as before.
The trace shows a vitest run after the change in which all tests pass, and the final response reports that result rather than claiming success without a run.
